command:
set -euo pipefail
CPU=$(nproc); LOAD=$(awk '{print $1}' /proc/loadavg); MEM=$(awk '/MemAvailable:/{print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo); python3 - <<PY
import sys
cpu=int('$CPU'); load=float('$LOAD'); mem=int('$MEM')
if mem < 1800 or load > max(2.0,cpu*0.90):
    print(f'BLOCKED host telemetry cpu={cpu} load1={load} mem={mem}MB', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(75)
print(f'ADMIT cpu={cpu} load1={load} mem={mem}MB')
PY
REPO=$HOME/frankenstein-repo
FEATURE='chatgpt/frank-continuum-harness-20260912'
REVIEW='chatgpt/frank-continuum-harness-review-gpt56sol-20260912'
git -C "$REPO" fetch origin "$FEATURE" "$REVIEW"
WT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/frank-organ-review.XXXXXX)
cleanup(){ git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$WT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$WT"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach "$WT" "origin/$REVIEW" >/dev/null
git -C "$WT" config user.name 'GPT-5.6 Sol review'
git -C "$WT" config user.email 'noreply@openai.com'
git -C "$WT" merge --no-edit "origin/$FEATURE"
python3 - "$WT" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
# 1) stern.py: expose the existing sent-url/result artifacts through the existing API.
p=root/'scripts/stern.py'; s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if 'def _chatgpt_sent_url_rows()' not in s:
    marker='

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ABSCHNITT: CHATGPT-FALLBACK'
    helper=r'''

def _chatgpt_sent_url_rows() -> list:
    """Structured view of the EXISTING burst-worker send ledger.

    No new state authority: sent_urls_v2.txt remains the producer-owned
    artifact. This helper only exposes exact conversation correlation to
    stern.py callers so they do not scrape logs or invent another ledger.
    """
    pfad = _CHATGPT_STATE_DIR / "sent_urls_v2.txt"
    if not pfad.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    try:
        lines = pfad.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
    except Exception:
        return []
    for line in lines:
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        worker_id, url = parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
        sent_at = parts[2].strip() if len(parts) > 2 else None
        m = re.search(r"/c/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)", url)
        if not m:
            continue
        rows.append({"worker_id": worker_id, "conversation_id": m.group(1),
                     "url": url, "sent_at": sent_at})
    return rows


def _chatgpt_harvest_results() -> list:
    """Read already-harvested result_<conversation-id>.txt artifacts.

    This is read-only over the existing burst-worker state directory.
    """
    out = []
    for row in _chatgpt_sent_url_rows():
        cid = row["conversation_id"]
        result_path = _CHATGPT_STATE_DIR / f"result_{cid}.txt"
        if not result_path.exists():
            continue
        try:
            antwort = result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except Exception:
            continue
        item = dict(row)
        item.update({"antwort": antwort[:120000], "result_file": str(result_path),
                     "result_sha256": hashlib.sha256(antwort.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()})
        out.append(item)
    return out
'''
    if marker not in s: raise SystemExit('stern marker missing')
    s=s.replace(marker, helper+marker, 1)
# snapshot send-ledger before each real send
s=s.replace('        vor = _chatgpt_zusammenfassung_neueste()
        timeout_s = max(120.0,',
'''        vor = _chatgpt_zusammenfassung_neueste()
        sent_vor_ids = {r["conversation_id"] for r in _chatgpt_sent_url_rows()}
        timeout_s = max(120.0,''',1)
s=s.replace('        nach = _chatgpt_zusammenfassung_neueste()
        neu = nach if nach != vor else None
        eintrag = {"trigger": text or "triggerwort2", "ok": r.get("rc") == 0, "rc": r.get("rc"),
                   "zusammenfassung": neu, "stderr_kurz": _kurz(r.get("stderr") or "", 400),
                   "recovery_log": r.get("recovery_log") or []}
',
'''        nach = _chatgpt_zusammenfassung_neueste()
        neu = nach if nach != vor else None
        sent_nach = _chatgpt_sent_url_rows()
        neue_convs = [x for x in sent_nach if x["conversation_id"] not in sent_vor_ids]
        eintrag = {"trigger": text or "triggerwort2", "ok": r.get("rc") == 0, "rc": r.get("rc"),
                   "zusammenfassung": neu, "conversation_ids": [x["conversation_id"] for x in neue_convs],
                   "sent_conversations": neue_convs,
                   "stderr_kurz": _kurz(r.get("stderr") or "", 400),
                   "recovery_log": r.get("recovery_log") or []}
''',1)
needle='''    ergebnis = {"ok": r.get("rc") == 0, "rc": r.get("rc"), "zusammenfassung": zusammenfassung,
            "stdout_letzte_zeilen": "\n".join(ausgabe.splitlines()[-15:]),
            "recovery_log": r.get("recovery_log") or [], "ausfall_403_verdacht": ausfall.get("ausfall")}
'''
repl='''    ergebnis = {"ok": r.get("rc") == 0, "rc": r.get("rc"), "zusammenfassung": zusammenfassung,
            "results": _chatgpt_harvest_results(),
            "stdout_letzte_zeilen": "\n".join(ausgabe.splitlines()[-15:]),
            "recovery_log": r.get("recovery_log") or [], "ausfall_403_verdacht": ausfall.get("ausfall")}
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('harvest return marker missing')
s=s.replace(needle,repl,1)
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')

# 2) organ: status summaries are never answers; correlate only this send's conversation ids.
p=root/'scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.py'; s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=s.replace('preferred = ("antwort", "response", "content", "text", "zusammenfassung", "summary")',
            'preferred = ("antwort", "response", "content", "text")',1)
if 'def _expected_conversation_ids(' not in s:
    marker='

def _insert_message('
    helper=r'''

def _expected_conversation_ids(send: Mapping[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
    out: set[str] = set()
    for run in send.get("laeufe") or []:
        if not isinstance(run, Mapping):
            continue
        for cid in run.get("conversation_ids") or []:
            if isinstance(cid, str) and cid.strip():
                out.add(cid.strip())
    return out

def _extract_correlated_harvest(harvest: Mapping[str, Any], expected: set[str]) -> str:
    """Return only answers belonging to this send; never historical harvest rows."""
    rows = []
    for row in harvest.get("results") or []:
        if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
            continue
        cid = str(row.get("conversation_id") or "")
        if expected and cid not in expected:
            continue
        answer = row.get("antwort")
        if isinstance(answer, str) and answer.strip():
            rows.append((str(row.get("worker_id") or "?"), cid, answer.strip()))
    if not rows:
        return ""
    rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    if len(rows) == 1:
        return rows[0][2][:120000]
    # Preserve every correlated worker proposal deterministically. Selection/
    # reduction is a later GRID/HCU concern; this layer must not silently pick.
    bundled = "\n\n".join(f"[CHATGPT_WORKER worker={wid} conversation={cid}]\n{ans}" for wid,cid,ans in rows)
    return bundled[:120000]
'''
    if marker not in s: raise SystemExit('organ insert marker missing')
    s=s.replace(marker,helper+marker,1)
old='''    direct = _extract_response(send)
    harvest = stern_module.chatgpt_ernten(timeout_s=900.0, lock_timeout_s=1200.0)
    response = _extract_response(harvest) or direct
'''
new='''    direct = _extract_response(send)
    expected_conversations = _expected_conversation_ids(send)
    harvest = stern_module.chatgpt_ernten(timeout_s=900.0, lock_timeout_s=1200.0)
    correlated = _extract_correlated_harvest(harvest, expected_conversations)
    # Direct text is valid only for a fallback/direct backend that did not create
    # browser conversation ids. Browser sends MUST be satisfied by correlated harvest.
    response = correlated or (direct if not expected_conversations else "")
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('organ harvest block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')

# 3) remote executor: same exact correlation, no global harvest answer.
p=root/'scripts/frank_chatgpt_remote_exec.py'; s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''    direct = organ._extract_response(send)
    harvest = stern.chatgpt_ernten(timeout_s=900.0, lock_timeout_s=1200.0)
    response = organ._extract_response(harvest) or direct
'''
new='''    direct = organ._extract_response(send)
    expected = organ._expected_conversation_ids(send)
    harvest = stern.chatgpt_ernten(timeout_s=900.0, lock_timeout_s=1200.0)
    response = organ._extract_correlated_harvest(harvest, expected) or (direct if not expected else "")
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('remote exec block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')

# 4) GitHub proxy: target identity travels WITH the command, not only receipt readback.
p=root/'scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_github_proxy.py'; s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''        cmd_doc = {
            "schema": "CLAY_LOCAL_COMMAND/v1",
            "command_id": command_id,
            "op": "exec",
'''
new='''        cmd_doc = {
            "schema": "CLAY_LOCAL_COMMAND/v1",
            "command_id": command_id,
            "machine_id": "ai-core-node",
            "owner": "gabriel",
            "op": "exec",
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('proxy cmd_doc marker missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')
PY
cd "$WT"
python3 -m py_compile scripts/stern.py scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.py scripts/frank_chatgpt_remote_exec.py scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_github_proxy.py
python3 scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ_gold_test.py
python3 scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ_real_harness_contract_test.py
git diff --check
git status --short
git add scripts/stern.py scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_organ.py scripts/frank_chatgpt_remote_exec.py scripts/f2wp1207_chatgpt_github_proxy.py
git commit -m 'fix: bind ChatGPT harvest to exact conversation receipts'
git push origin HEAD:"$REVIEW"
echo REVIEW_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
